2607.01751.title: MedStreamBench: A Time-Aware Benchmark for Streaming and Proactive Medical Video Understanding
2607.01751.paper_summary: Existing medical video benchmarks primarily evaluate whether a model produces the correct answer, but rarely assess whether it answers at the right time. In real clinical settings, AI systems must decide not only what to predict, but also when to answer, defer judgment, or proactively raise alerts. This creates a critical gap between benchmark evaluation and deployment requirements. We present MedStreamBench, a benchmark for time-aware medical video understanding. MedStreamBench integrates 22 medical datasets and 5,419 QA instances across four temporal settings: retrospective, present, future, and proactive. Unlike conventional benchmarks that assume full-video access, MedStreamBench restricts models to temporally bounded evidence windows and supports both single-turn and streaming evaluation. We further introduce a proactive monitoring setting that requires models to determine whether and when clinically relevant alerts should be triggered. Beyond answer correctness, MedStreamBench evaluates temporal behavior through responsiveness and post-evidence stability. Experiments on leading general-purpose and medical vision-language models reveal a substantial gap between offline recognition and temporally grounded decision-making, with performance dropping markedly in streaming and proactive settings. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Venn2024/MedStreamBench.
2607.01751.paper_summary_zh: 現有的醫療視頻基準主要評估模型是否產生正確答案，但很少評估其是否在正確的時間回答。在真實的臨床環境中，AI 系統必須決定不僅要預測什麼，還要在何時回答、推遲判斷或主動提出警報。這在基準評估與部署需求之間創造了一個關鍵的差距。我們提出了 MedStreamBench，一個針對時間感知醫療視頻理解的基準。MedStreamBench 整合了 22 個醫療數據集和 5,419 個 QA 實例，涵蓋四種時間設定：回顧性、當前、未來和主動。與假設完全視頻訪問的傳統基準不同，MedStreamBench 限制模型在時間上有界的證據窗口，並支持單輪和流式評估。我們進一步引入了一個主動監控設定，要求模型確定何時以及是否應觸發臨床相關的警報。除了答案的正確性外，MedStreamBench 還通過反應能力和後證據穩定性來評估時間行為。在領先的通用和醫療視覺語言模型上的實驗顯示，離線識別與時間基礎決策之間存在顯著差距，且在流式和主動設定中的性能明顯下降。我們的基準可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Venn2024/MedStreamBench 獲得。
